description: Source code for the ASPEED AST10x0 reset driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing reset line control functions.

methods.name: aspeed_reset_line_assert
methods.description: Asserts (asserts reset) for a specific reset line identified by id.

methods.name: aspeed_reset_line_deassert
methods.description: Deasserts (releases reset) for a specific reset line identified by id.

methods.name: aspeed_reset_status
methods.description: Checks the status of a reset line.

methods.name: aspeed_reset_line_toggle
methods.description: Toggles the reset line (assert then deassert).
